title: Less interface. More film. | Vela for Mac
description:
Real Vela Mac playback: controls appear when needed and disappear again, leaving the film. The last three seconds hold the completed clean-window result. “Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.” — Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. The on-screen excerpt uses the wording supplied by the owner.

Vela for macOS · Beta. Local files work without a Jellyfin server. Jellyfin features require your server; episode prompts depend on available chapters/segments and metadata. VLC is the default local playback engine; compatibility depends on the file.
Discover Vela: https://ralleur.github.io/Vela/
